original.reason: The even-case CRT system is not guaranteed compatible merely because both prescribed residues are even: compatibility requires m_0≡0 modulo gcd(phi(M),2^a), which can be stronger than parity. Also the argument applies claims requiring M>1 to M=1.

judgment.reason: Its final CRT compatibility claim is false: even residues need not agree modulo gcd(phi(M),2^a), which may exceed 2.
